title: Navy Velvet Study
reference_source: Бельевая линия — максимальный гламурный регистр, 8 кадров, без наушников
mood_ru: Старый кабинет, книги до потолка, настольная лампа. Тёмно-синий бархатный сет.
allure: lingerie editorial glamour at its boldest, set with full opaque lining, deep neckline and high-cut briefs, sculpted waist and long legs fully on show, unhurried commanding sensuality, direct gaze, deep navy velvet set with a plunging neckline against old leather and books
film: shot on Kodak Portra 800, warm lamp halation and grain

wardrobe.notes_ru: Тёмно-синий бархатный комплект с подкладкой, глубокий вырез.
wardrobe.prompt: deep navy velvet lingerie set with full opaque lining, plunging balconette cut and high-leg briefs, sheer navy stockings, silver star pendant, hair pinned up loosely, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Кабинет со стеллажами до потолка, кожаное кресло, зелёная лампа.
location.prompt: old private study, floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, heavy oak desk, worn leather armchair, green glass desk lamp, globe, persian rug, dark panelled walls, warm pooled light

shots.pose: sitting up on the edge of the heavy desk in the navy velvet set, one leg stretched to the floor and the other bent up on the wood, leaning back on one hand, chin raised, level gaze at the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly low angle, three-quarter front, full body framing
shots.light: warm desk lamp close from the side, deep shadow across the bookshelves behind

shots.pose: kneeling up in the worn leather armchair with her back to the camera, both hands on the chair back, spine deeply arched, looking over her shoulder into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: single lamp raking along her back, warm falloff into the dark study

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the heavy oak desk, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: one warm desk lamp close and low on her, faint cool light from the curtained window behind

shots.pose: standing close to the dark glass of the bookcase door, one hand flat on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, meeting the camera past her own reflection
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: one warm desk lamp close and low on her, faint cool light from the curtained window behind

shots.pose: standing at the narrow curtained study window with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, the long line of her back and legs read against the light, head turned just enough to find the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: one warm desk lamp close and low on her, faint cool light from the curtained window behind

shots.pose: reclining back on the heavy oak desk propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: one warm desk lamp close and low on her, faint cool light from the curtained window behind

shots.pose: standing tall in the pool of lamplight between the shelves, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight on one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: one warm desk lamp close and low on her, faint cool light from the curtained window behind

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the velvet edge of the cup and the pendant lying against her skin, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: one warm desk lamp close and low on her, faint cool light from the curtained window behind
